title: Use English source keys for Atlas and information views
changes: Migrate 59 Atlas, information and debug-tool message keys to English while retaining their existing English and Italian translations, legacy keys and formatted placeholders.
validation: Offline Linux combined menu/screen build passed the full menu suite: 115 tests passed and one optional test was ignored. A focused regression compares all 59 legacy and new keys in both locales and checks literal placeholder values; both 574-entry catalogs validate.
limitations: Runtime frontend build, native Windows and physical input were not checked; the broader English-first audit remains open.
